details.completeness_justification: All eight key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S1 (revenue growth), S3 (EBITDA improvement), and S4 (H2 positive EBITDA). K2 is covered by S8 (CARR growth), S9 (CAC payback), and S10 (churn rate). K3 is covered by S13 (product suite expansion) and S14 (product launches). K4 is covered by S11 (new customers and average size) and S15 (partner-driven growth). K5 is covered by S5 (cost savings), S6 (cash flow improvement), and S10 (churn reduction plans). K6 is covered by S17 (private placements and equity positions). K7 is covered by S10 (churn guidance) and S18 (2026 financial guidance). K8 is covered by S16 (Iberia growth). No material omissions affect the overall understanding.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically support the overall narrative of financial improvement and strategic progress. There are no self-contradictions: growth metrics (S1-S2), profitability improvements (S3-S5), operational metrics (S6, S7, S9-S11), strategic initiatives (S13-S15), and financial stability measures (S17) all align without conflict. The organization flows logically from financial results to operational metrics to strategic actions. While some metrics show mixed signals (e.g., churn rate increase in S10), these are explicitly framed as areas for improvement rather than contradictions. No unnecessary repetition materially reduces clarity. The summary forms a coherent whole that tells a consistent story of progress with targeted areas for future improvement.
